title: Zero Forcing in Generalized Petersen Graphs
headline: An independent Lean 4 formalisation and Palomar-verified snapshot of $Z(P(n,3))=8$ for every $n\ge 13$, retained as an archived alternative after prior-art review.
description: This project studies zero forcing in generalized Petersen graphs and establishes $Z(P(n,3))=8$ for every integer $n\ge 13$ via an audited proof architecture, reproducible computational certificates, and a complete Lean 4 formalisation. The Lean development passed its kernel and transitive-axiom audits, and the registered snapshot passed Palomar verification. A later prior-art audit identified an earlier public proof and an earlier independent Lean formalisation, so this repository is archived as an alternative verification route rather than a novelty or priority claim.
verification: Mathematical proof audit passed; the Lean 4 formalisation is complete and passed its final kernel/transitive-axiom audit; Palomar verification passed and the immutable snapshot is registered as PALOMAR-2026-09-27-000004 v1.
attribution: The corrected target appears as Conjecture 5 in Arnav Krishnan's July 2026 preprint, after a 2020 paper by Rashidi, Shajareh Poursalavati, and Tavakkoli had claimed the stronger $n\ge 12$ statement. John Fairfax-Ball's contribution in this repository is an alternative proof and verification architecture, computational certification, and an independent Lean 4 formalisation. The prior-art audit found an earlier public proof package by txmy and an earlier independent Lean formalisation by TrueTuring, so no first-proof, first-formalisation, novelty, or publication-priority claim is made.
